meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 让应用快速接入 Matrix 聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里集成 Matrix 通讯渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Matrix chat channels to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Matrix messaging into your app

howto.what: 把 Matrix 频道接入 Chat SDK 桥：从 channels 分支复制适配器、注册进 barrel、安装 @beeper/chat-adapter-matrix@0.2.0、修补 matrix-js-sdk 的 ESM 导入，再跑构建与测试。另需你手动注册独立的机器人 Matrix 账号并填好凭据。
howto.when: 当你需要给 NanoClaw 加上 Matrix 频道支持时；原文称适用于任何 Matrix homeserver。凭据创建步骤需你本人在 Element 里手动完成。

say.text: 用 add-matrix 把 Matrix 频道接进来
say.note: 它会复制适配器、装依赖并跑构建测试

say.text: 用 Access Token 方式配置 Matrix 机器人
say.note: 改用 MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN，而非用户名密码

say.text: 跑 matrix-registration 测试看注册是否生效
say.note: 红灯说明 barrel 导入或依赖漂移

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support to NanoClaw via the Chat SDK bridge: copies the adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the adapter package, patches matrix-js-sdk ESM imports, then builds and tests. You create a bot account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Matrix channel support to NanoClaw; works with any Matrix homeserver. The credential steps are done by hand in Element.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel with add-matrix
say_en.note: It copies the adapter, installs deps, builds and tests

say_en.text: Configure the Matrix bot with an access token
say_en.note: Uses MATRIX_ACCESS_TOKEN instead of username and password
Red means the barrel import or dependency drifted
